[Story]
Xiao Ming's teacher often gives students a lot of homework. This weekend, Xiao Ming wants to go to his friend Xiao Chen's house to play games together. But Xiao Ming still has a lot of homework that he does not finish. Xiao Ming's father sees him working hard all day on his homework, and asks Xiao Ming if he finishes his homework? Does he want to go out and play for a rest? Xiao Ming says, "No, I do not want to."

[Question]
Why does Xiao Ming say he does not want to go out and play?

[Candidate Answers]
A. Because he finds it hard to finish the homework.
B. Because he thinks the homework is too hard, so he lies and says he does not want to go.
C. Because he forgets the homework.
D. Because he does not want his father to think he is a child who loves to play.
